test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following numbers are divisible by 11?

(i) 29435417

(ii) 57463828

(iii 57463824

(iv) 29435416
solution:
**Formula used:**

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of the digits in the odd positions and the sum of the digits in the even positions is either 0 or a multiple of 11.

**Calculation:**

(i) 29435417:

Sum of digits at odd positions: 2 + 4 + 5 + 1 = 12

Sum of digits at even positions: 9 + 3 + 4 + 7 = 23

⇒ Difference: |12 - 23| = 11 (Divisible by 11)

(ii) 57463828:

Sum of digits at odd positions: 5 + 4 + 3 + 2 = 14

Sum of digits at even positions: 7 + 6 + 8 + 8 = 29

⇒ Difference: |14 - 29| = 15 (Not divisible by 11)

(iii) 57463824:

Sum of digits at odd positions: 5 + 4 + 3 + 2 = 14

Sum of digits at even positions: 7 + 6 + 8 + 4 = 25

⇒ Difference: |14 - 25| = 11 (Divisible by 11)

(iv) 29435416:

Sum of digits at odd positions: 2 + 4 + 5 + 1 = 12

Sum of digits at even positions: 9 + 3 + 4 + 6 = 22

⇒ Difference: |12 - 22| = 10 (Not divisible by 11)

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
